module: Facade of the vehicle selector's details panel. It assembles the specifications (ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleSpecifications) and the action buttons (ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleOperations) of an item, and exposes a few actions (open a folder, go to a mod's page). A custom buttons mode lets other systems (challenge mode) replace the freeroam buttons.
notes: If customDetailsButtons is not empty, the standard buttons are replaced: each button calls button.callback(modelKey, configKey, additionalData). Without additional data, the default paints (paint, paint2, paint3) of the config, or failing that of the model, are pre-filled.
The managementButtonsEnabled field of this module is not read here; setManagementButtonsEnabled delegates to vehicleOperations.

customDetailsButtons.desc: Custom buttons ({callback, meta}); empty by default.

exitCallback.desc: Exit callback, nop by default; modified by setExitCallback.

getDetails.desc: Returns the details of an item (specifications from vehicleSpecifications) completed with `buttonInfo`: custom buttons if defined, otherwise the standard launch buttons of vehicleOperations.

getManagementDetails.desc: Returns the details of the management buttons provided by vehicleOperations.getManagementDetails().

setExitCallback.desc: Sets the function called on exit; nop if nil.

exploreFolder.desc: Opens a folder in the system file explorer (Engine.Platform.exploreFolder).

goToMod.desc: Navigates to a mod's details page in the interface (route 'menu.mods.details').

executeButton.desc: Delegates to ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleOperations.executeButton with the same arguments.

executeDoubleClick.desc: Delegates to ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleOperations.executeDoubleClick with the same arguments.

setCustomDetailsButtons.desc: Sets the list of custom buttons that replace the standard buttons in getDetails.
